verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe reading issues (Jira/GitHub), writing code across files, running tests, staging changes, committing, and opening PRs end-to-end, including Slack-triggered 'get a pull request back' and GitHub Actions CI workflows. Community evidence corroborates real-world multi-language use but also notes reliability caveats on complex tasks, so end-to-end success isn't guaranteed on every issue. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a full issue-to-merged-PR run with no human intervention, and quantified success-rate data.
